finding.summary: 未实现按 QoS 桶独立集群的 silo 部署

paper.quote: Sarathi-Silo (SOTA), the State-of-the-art siloed deployment where each QoS bucket is assigned an independent GPU cluster with each replica running a Sarathi scheduler

analysis.tier_note: the probes confirm what the Finding says
analysis.reasoning: The cited scripts launch a single Sarathi/DEADLINE benchmark process per run and assign one scheduler type per GPU. They contain no orchestration for independent per-QoS-bucket GPU clusters, so the paper's Sarathi-Silo baseline is not implemented in the shown code.
analysis.would_confirm: A repository-wide search for a launcher starting separate Sarathi replicas on distinct GPU clusters per QoS bucket; finding none confirms the gap.

probes.meaning: No silo/QoS cluster orchestration; only per-GPU scheduler sweeps.
Each GPU runs one scheduler type, not independent QoS-bucket clusters.
Only a single Sarathi benchmark process is launched per run.
